mapper.select: SELECT b.BID_ID, b.AUCTION_ID, b.USER_ID, b.BID_PRICE, b.BID_STATUS, b.BID_TIME, b.CREATED_TIME, a.TITLE as AUCTION_TITLE, a.END_DATE as AUCTION_END_DATE, u.USER_NAME as BIDDER_NAME, (SELECT MAX(BID_PRICE) FROM bids WHERE AUCTION_ID = b.AUCTION_ID) as CURRENT_HIGHEST_BID, CASE WHEN b.BID_PRICE = (SELECT MAX(BID_PRICE) FROM bids WHERE AUCTION_ID = b.AUCTION_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as IS_WINNER FROM bids b LEFT JOIN auctions a ON b.AUCTION_ID = a.AUCTION_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON b.USER_ID = u.ID WHERE b.USER_ID = #{bidderId} ORDER BY b.BID_TIME DESC

SELECT b.BID_ID, b.AUCTION_ID, b.USER_ID, b.BID_PRICE, b.BID_STATUS, b.BID_TIME, b.CREATED_TIME, a.TITLE as AUCTION_TITLE, a.END_DATE as AUCTION_END_DATE, u.USER_NAME as BIDDER_NAME, b.BID_PRICE as CURRENT_HIGHEST_BID, 1 as IS_WINNER FROM bids b LEFT JOIN auctions a ON b.AUCTION_ID = a.AUCTION_ID LEFT JOIN users u ON b.USER_ID = u.ID WHERE b.USER_ID = #{bidderId} AND b.BID_PRICE = (SELECT MAX(BID_PRICE) FROM bids WHERE AUCTION_ID = b.AUCTION_ID) AND a.AUCTION_STATUS = 'ENDED' ORDER BY b.BID_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bids (BID_ID, AUCTION_ID, USER_ID, BID_PRICE, BID_STATUS, BID_TIME, CREATED_TIME) VALUES (bid_seq.NEXTVAL, #{auctionId}, #{userId}, #{bidPrice}, #{bidStatus}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(BID_PRICE) FROM bids WHERE AUCTION_ID = #{auctionId}

SELECT a.AUCTION_ID, a.WINNER_ID as USER_ID, a.CURRENT_BID_PRICE as BID_PRICE, 'WON' as BID_STATUS, a.END_DATE as BID_TIME, a.END_DATE as CREATED_TIME, a.TITLE as AUCTION_TITLE, a.END_DATE as AUCTION_END_DATE, u.USER_NAME as BIDDER_NAME, a.CURRENT_BID_PRICE as CURRENT_HIGHEST_BID, 1 as IS_WINNER FROM AUCTIONS a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.WINNER_ID = u.ID WHERE a.WINNER_ID = #{winnerId} AND a.AUCTION_STATUS = 'ENDED' AND a.CURRENT_BID_PRICE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.END_DATE DESC
